proposal.summary: Authenticated user can trigger a denial of service in GitLab when importing or cloning malicious content in affected versions (15.11 < 16.1.5, 16.2 < 16.2.5, 16.3 < 16.3.1).
proposal.affected_product: GitLab, versions 15.11 up to before 16.1.5; 16.2 up to before 16.2.5; 16.3 up to before 16.3.1

proposal.recommended_next_step: Review GitLab advisory and apply the vendor-provided patches for the affected versions; if patching is not immediately possible, restrict or monitor repository import/clone operations to authenticated users and review logs for suspicious import activity.
